He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?
Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?
It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”

translations.web: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?
translations.bsb: Then He asked, “To what can we compare the kingdom of God? With what parable shall we present it?
translations.kjv: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
translations.asv: And he said, How shall we liken the kingdom of God? or in what parable shall we set it forth?
